meta.title: TraceCart — Get it there.
meta.description: Sourcing and cross-border logistics for landlocked and difficult-to-reach markets. Tell us what needs to move — we'll work out the route.

hero.overline: Sourcing and logistics for hard-to-reach places
hero.title: Get it there.
hero.body: We source, move and deliver goods to landlocked and difficult-to-reach markets. Tell us what needs to move. We will work out the route.

howItWorks.title: Five steps. You only see one: delivered.

source.title: Source
source.body: We find the supplier, check the goods, and pay them safely.

consolidate.title: Consolidate
consolidate.body: Your cargo joins others at a hub, so you only pay for the space you use.

move.title: Move
move.body: Sea, rail and road, planned as one route and tracked as one shipment.

clear.title: Clear
clear.body: Our brokers handle customs and border papers before the truck arrives.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.body: To the door, with a signed, photographed proof of delivery.

proof.photoCaption: Documentary photo: the Dakola border crossing at 4 a.m. — a TraceCart broker walking the queue with a clipboard. Real place, real people, no staging.
